jobs_location_complete.name: jobs_location_complete
jobs_location_complete.value: ("jobs"."location_lat" IS NULL) = ("jobs"."location_lng" IS NULL) AND ("jobs"."location_lat" IS NULL) = ("jobs"."location_radius_m" IS NULL)

work_session_events_location_accuracy_wi.name: work_session_events_location_accuracy_with_fix
work_session_events_location_accuracy_wi.value: "work_session_events"."location_accuracy_m" IS NULL OR "work_session_events"."location_lat" IS NOT NULL

approvals_material_corrected.name: approvals_material_corrected
approvals_material_corrected.value: "approvals"."material_correction_id" IS NULL OR (coalesce('corrected'::approval_reason = ANY ("approvals"."reasons"), false) AND array_position("approvals"."reasons", NULL) IS NULL)

approvals_decision_complete.name: approvals_decision_complete
approvals_decision_complete.value: ("approvals"."decision" IS NULL) = ("approvals"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("approvals"."decision" IS NULL) = ("approvals"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL)

invoices_void_after_issue.name: invoices_void_after_issue
invoices_void_after_issue.value: "invoices"."voided_at" IS NULL OR "invoices"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL

audit_log_snapshot_present.name: audit_log_snapshot_present
audit_log_snapshot_present.value: "audit_log"."before" IS NOT NULL OR "audit_log"."after" IS NOT NULL

material_corrections_shape.name: material_corrections_shape
material_corrections_shape.value:
("material_corrections"."kind" = 'amend' AND "material_corrections"."description" IS NOT NULL AND "material_corrections"."quantity" IS NOT NULL
        AND "material_corrections"."unit" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("material_corrections"."description") <> '' AND "material_corrections"."quantity" > 0
        AND btrim("material_corrections"."unit") <> '')
      OR ("material_corrections"."kind" = 'void' AND "material_corrections"."description" IS NULL AND "material_corrections"."quantity" IS NULL
        AND "material_corrections"."unit" IS NULL)

sync_diagnostics_request_failed_has_no_r.name: sync_diagnostics_request_failed_has_no_record
sync_diagnostics_request_failed_has_no_r.value: "sync_diagnostics"."outcome" <> 'request_failed' OR ("sync_diagnostics"."record_id" IS NULL AND "sync_diagnostics"."record_kind" IS NULL)
